def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    barrier = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if barrier is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    direction = -1 if barrier > h // 2 else 1
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)}
    objects = []
    while cells:
        seed = cells.pop(); color = grid[seed[0]][seed[1]]
        obj = {seed}; stack = [seed]
        while stack:
            r,c = stack.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in cells and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                    cells.remove(p); obj.add(p); stack.append(p)
        objects.append((color,obj))
    # Sequential gravity: process pieces from nearest the wall outward, allowing stacking.
    order = sorted(range(len(objects)), key=lambda i: min(r for r,c in objects[i][1]) if direction < 0 else -max(r for r,c in objects[i][1]))
    occupied = set()
    settled = []
    for i in order:
        color,obj = objects[i]
        while True:
            moved = {(r+direction,c) for r,c in obj}
            if (direction < 0 and min(r for r,c in moved) <= barrier) or (direction > 0 and max(r for r,c in moved) >= barrier) or moved & occupied:
                break
            obj = moved
        occupied |= obj
        settled.append((color,obj))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[barrier] = grid[barrier][:]
    for color,obj in settled:
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c] = color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    wall = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if wall is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Objects are independently translated along their gravity column/shape trajectory.
    direction = -1 if wall > h//2 else 1
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color in (0,2) or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); obj={(r,c)}
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                for p in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    py,px=p
                    if 0<=py<h and 0<=px<w and p not in seen and grid[py][px]==color:
                        seen.add(p);obj.add(p);stack.append(p)
            objs.append((color,obj))
    # Move each object toward wall in order of proximity, treating already-settled objects as obstacles.
    objs.sort(key=lambda z: min(r for r,c in z[1]) if direction<0 else -max(r for r,c in z[1]))
    occupied=set(); settled=[]
    for color,obj in objs:
        while True:
            nxt={(r+direction,c) for r,c in obj}
            if (direction<0 and min(r for r,c in nxt)<=wall) or (direction>0 and max(r for r,c in nxt)>=wall) or nxt&occupied: break
            obj=nxt
        occupied |= obj; settled.append((color,obj))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)];out[wall]=grid[wall][:]
    for color,obj in settled:
        for r,c in obj:out[r][c]=color
    return out
